short: Data scale is the real advance (3,886 h, 0 of 59 earlier studies at 1,000 h); the phoneme+WFST 'first' claim fails against 2016-17 priors; LRS3 transfer confounded: standard.
position: M02, M06 and M07 changed, all standard. M02: the 3,886-hour mined YouTube corpus exceeds every earlier sentence-level lip-reading corpus in the ledger (0 of 59 at 1,000 hours or more) but no training-size ablation measures its effect. M06: the 'first' claim for deep phoneme recognition with production-grade word decoding is contradicted by Thangthai and Harvey 2017 (DNN-HMM + Kaldi WFST, visual-only) and approached by Sanabria et al. 2016 (CTC + Eesen WFSTs, audio-visual); the measured phoneme gain is 3.2 WER points on one test set. M07: the LM-free ablation is a strength, but the LM corpus is unnamed and the vocabulary-extension claim untested. M12: human subsets differ from the model's full test, intervals are bootstrap over one run, and zero-shot LRS3 against a concurrent system mixes data, decoder, LM and possible TED overlap.
